domain_stopping_review.reason: Contract distinctions triangulated with ODD/OIC; product procedures need live worksheet.
Event/vintage design set; no causal macro trading effect claimed.
Math dependency and numerical benchmarks set; advanced derivation review remains P17.
Optional placement justified by evidence limitations; exhaustive pattern efficacy search has low expected design value.
Signed-leg accounting supports all structure families; variant lessons remain.
BSM/parity benchmarks and numerical failure design ready; advanced algorithms require implementation validation.
Variance/surface evidence changes adopted; exact VIX method and deeper model texts are targeted blockers.
Specialist-only scope prevents generalizing equity conventions; product term sheets required for lessons.
Joint loss/funding/operational framework set; margin constants intentionally excluded.
Inventory and adverse-selection distinction set; venue-specific rules need exact reading.
Leakage/rights controls and synthetic route set; licensed chains unavailable without entitlement.
Practice review designed; measured training efficacy not claimed.
High-value circular conflicts exposed; current-rule certification awaits masters/operative chains.
Case mechanisms bounded; avoid accumulating famous anecdotes.
